Photograph of the white-border [[IG-88 (Revised)]] card. The card was published by [[Decipher]]; the photograph is published in StarWarsCollector_#1’s PSA Set Registry gallery. The photographer is not identified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/137798219/Ok_ZHzLdsEuc7MBAjfPtmA.jpg complete card photograph]. [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 Collector gallery].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1428 × 2400-pixel source is retained unchanged. Rectangle (145, 620)–(1285, 2200) was extracted with the right and bottom coordinates exclusive, retaining the complete photographed card and a narrow surrounding margin. It was downsampled with Lanczos resampling to 350 × 485 pixels and saved as PNG. Printed words, artwork, icons and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic crop. The source image’s holder or capture date is not used to infer the card’s first publication date.
